purpose: Primary-study mechanism catalog plus explicit unverified leads. Gene overlap alone never establishes native isoform correspondence.

genes.published_mechanism: CD45 variable extracellular cassette (published exons 4/5/6)
genes.context_and_limit: Naive versus memory/activated lymphocytes; RA/RB/RC/RO differ by cassette inclusion

genes.published_mechanism: Protein 4.1R spectrin-actin-binding cassette exon 16 (21 aa)
genes.context_and_limit: Late erythroid exon inclusion stabilizes the red-cell membrane skeleton; alternative first exons/translation are separate mechanisms

genes.published_mechanism: Fox2A versus Fox2F alternative amino termini
genes.context_and_limit: Erythroid differentiation changes Fox2 isoform balance and regulation of EPB41 splicing

genes.published_mechanism: NF-YA long versus short; 29-aa exon-3 cassette
genes.context_and_limit: Short form enriched in immature hematopoietic cells; HSC self-renewal and AML isoform-dependent activity

genes.published_mechanism: p37 versus p32; loss of first two zinc fingers by cassette skipping
genes.context_and_limit: Isoform-specific erythroid/megakaryocyte requirements and platelet disease

genes.published_mechanism: HMGA2-L versus HMGA2-S alternative terminal exon and 3-prime UTR
genes.context_and_limit: Developmental human HSC switch alters let-7 regulation; coding and UTR changes require separate verification

genes.published_mechanism: BMP2K-L versus BMP2K-S alternative C-terminal region
genes.context_and_limit: Antagonistic effects on COPII and autophagic degradation in erythroid cells

genes.published_mechanism: RUNX1b/c alternative P2/P1 promoters; RUNX1a alternative termination; exon-6 cassette
genes.context_and_limit: Different mechanisms have hematopoietic precedents; a tiny ORF is not RUNX1a

genes.published_mechanism: HEBAlt/HEBCan alternative first exon; distinct human 24-aa insertion also described
genes.context_and_limit: HEBAlt has a unique 23-aa N-terminus and T-lineage roles; do not conflate it with the human 72-nt cassette

genes.published_mechanism: TCF1 long/short alternative promoters
genes.context_and_limit: Long isoforms retain N-terminal beta-catenin-binding region; distinct mature-T-cell responses

genes.published_mechanism: PBX1a/b alternative C-terminal splice products
genes.context_and_limit: PBX1b enriched in early progenitors; the cited developmental study does not establish a unique function for each native pair

genes.published_mechanism: LynA/LynB internal 21-aa N-terminal insert
genes.context_and_limit: Distinct contributions to immune homeostasis; LynB protects against autoimmunity

genes.published_mechanism: MyD88-L/S exon-2 cassette; short lacks residues 110-154 (45 aa)
genes.context_and_limit: Inducible negative regulator of inflammatory NF-kappaB signaling in monocytes/macrophages

genes.published_mechanism: MCL1-L/S exon-2 skipping and altered C terminus
genes.context_and_limit: Long anti-apoptotic versus short pro-apoptotic; literal sequence and frameshift must match

genes.published_mechanism: Exon-6 skipping removes transmembrane region
genes.context_and_limit: Soluble IL7R modifies IL7 activity and lymphoid/immune phenotypes

genes.published_mechanism: Alternative promoters/starts DNMT3A1/2; DNMT3A4 C-terminal truncation
genes.context_and_limit: Variant-specific methylation and proliferation/differentiation effects in human HSPCs

genes.published_mechanism: MDS1-EVI1 versus EVI1 alternative promoter; EVI1 delta324 separate event
genes.context_and_limit: PR-domain-containing MDS1-EVI1 regulates LT-HSC quiescence; not every MECOM splice pair is this promoter pair

genes.published_mechanism: Alternative P1/P2 promoters and first exons
genes.context_and_limit: Hematopoietic promoter identity; expression specificity does not prove pair-specific protein function

genes.published_mechanism: Alternative splice products of the sialomucin
genes.context_and_limit: CD34-positive cell adhesion and isoform-specific epitopes; exact splice correspondence required

genes.published_mechanism: FOXP1 long versus short internal promoters/first exons
genes.context_and_limit: Short isoforms in normal germinal-center B cells and ABC-DLBCL; exon-9 skipping alone is not FOXP1S

genes.published_mechanism: GNNK-positive/negative 4-aa extracellular insert
genes.context_and_limit: Different SCF responses in early myeloid progenitors and mast cells; large truncations are not GNNK switches

genes.published_mechanism: CD33 full length versus delta-exon-2 (IgV loss)
genes.context_and_limit: AML-relevant antigen and immune-regulatory differences

genes.published_mechanism: Mutually exclusive FynT/FynB exon-7 sequence; delta7 separate
genes.context_and_limit: Different T-cell antigen responses; each event must be distinguished

genes.published_mechanism: TC45/TC48 alternative C-terminal splice products
genes.context_and_limit: Different nuclear/ER localization; cited rescue result tested lymphoma/other cells, not normal lineage switching

genes.published_mechanism: FcgammaRIIb1/b2 47-aa cytoplasmic insertion
genes.context_and_limit: B-cell versus myeloid expression and receptor endocytosis

genes.published_mechanism: Exon-9 PRR cassette (48 aa); exon-3 PTB cassette is separate
genes.context_and_limit: NUMB-S supports hemogenic endothelial specification through NOTCH

genes.published_mechanism: Bcl-xL/Bcl-xS alternative splice site; internal 63-aa segment
genes.context_and_limit: Opposing survival effects; lineage context and exact splice mechanism required

genes.published_mechanism: Nuclear-localization cassette exon 5
genes.context_and_limit: Exon inclusion during terminal erythropoiesis promotes nuclear splicing; tiny truncated ORFs do not establish this mechanism

genes.published_mechanism: 32/30 versus 27/14-kDa isoforms; alternative starts/splicing
genes.context_and_limit: Isoforms alter eosinophil/neutrophil/erythroid outcomes in human CD34-positive progenitors

genes.published_mechanism: Syk-L/S internal 23-aa linker deletion
genes.context_and_limit: Differential hematopoietic contexts; some phagocytosis assays find similar activity

genes.published_mechanism: Long/short N-terminal products from multiple RNA and translation routes
genes.context_and_limit: Distinct hematopoietic effects and E-protein interactions; RNA start/splice route must be demonstrated

genes.published_mechanism: PKM1/PKM2 mutually exclusive coding exons 9/10; both 531 aa
genes.context_and_limit: Metabolic dependencies during hematopoietic activation/differentiation

genes.published_mechanism: XL/L/S/XS alternative terminal coding structures
genes.context_and_limit: Different zinc-finger complements; erythroid isoform expression and function require precise matching

genes.published_mechanism: Full length/short lacks N-terminal 83 aa
genes.context_and_limit: Splicing out exon 2 can produce GATA1s, but alternative translation also does; a protein-length difference is insufficient

genes.published_mechanism: Alternative exons 8A/9A/9B/10A/13A/14A
genes.context_and_limit: Lineage-specific splice usage and distinct transcriptional activity; historical 9A/9B naming differs

genes.published_mechanism: p51/p42 exon-VII cassette
genes.context_and_limit: Distinct DNA binding and lymphocyte maturation/homeostasis effects

genes.published_mechanism: IRAK4-L/S exon-4 inclusion/skipping
genes.context_and_limit: U2AF1-associated myeloid cancer splice switch changes innate immune signaling

genes.published_mechanism: Class-I/IV alternative distal exon; intron-3 cryptic exon is separate
genes.context_and_limit: Granulopoietic and leukemic receptor processing; exact distal versus cryptic event distinction required

genes.published_mechanism: 185-aa long versus 161-aa short cytoplasmic tail
genes.context_and_limit: Isoform-specific adhesion and T-cell developmental expression; nonhematopoietic functional assays are a separate context

genes.published_mechanism: IRE1-mediated 26-nt unconventional intron excision
genes.context_and_limit: Plasma-cell immunoglobulin production; nonspliceosomal event may be absent from conventional junction catalogs
